# Create the transform function based on the pattern learned from demo
def transform_grid(grid):
    """
    Transform grid by filling 1s in diamond shapes between 3-structures,
    respecting vertical 2-line boundaries at columns 2, 7, 11, 16.
    """
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
